title: 第36章 大圣眼皮跳
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 温栩栩试探问：“那游戏呢？大圣，您要不要试试我们人间的手机游戏？”大圣一听到游戏两个字就来劲儿了，挑眉：“游戏？什么游戏？”温栩栩点开王者农药手游，翻到英雄列表：“您看！”屏幕上，一个头戴凤翅紫金冠、身穿锁子黄金甲、手持如意金箍棒的角色，正威风凛凛地站着。英雄角色写着三个大字：孙悟空。大圣愣住了。他盯着那个角色看了三秒，又凑近一点，再看了三秒。然后他开口，声音都变了调：“这……这是俺老孙？”温栩栩用力点头：“对呀！我们凡间可崇拜您了！您就是超级英雄，游戏里有您，电影里有您，动画片里也有您——都是能上天入地的主角！”“哦？”大圣用温栩栩的脸做出一个“说来听听”的表情，语气里却已经藏不住那股得意劲儿，“都是主角？都是那种大杀四方、无人能敌的？”温栩栩疯狂点头：“对对对！您永远是最厉害的那个！”话音刚落，她脸上的表情忽然切换了一下——眉毛一挑，嘴角一歪，带着点“这还用说”的臭屁劲儿，是孙悟空的表情。下一秒又切回她自已，眼睛亮晶晶地疯狂点头。再下一秒，孙悟空又冒出来，用她的脸露出一个“算你们凡人有眼光”的满意笑容。一张脸，两副表情，切换得跟翻书似的。如果这会儿有人推门进来，一定会以为温栩栩精神分裂了。大圣满意地“嗯”了一声，借温栩栩的身体握紧手机，盯着屏幕上那个头戴凤翅紫金冠、手持如意金箍棒的自已，眼睛越来越亮。大圣左看看，右看看，放大缩小，再放大看看。然后小声嘀咕了一句：“……有点意思。”大圣对王者农药这个游戏跃跃欲试：“丫头，这玩意儿怎么玩？”温栩栩点开那个叫王者荣耀的游戏，开始给大圣当解说员：“这个就是您，孙悟空，打野位，技能是……”“行了行了，俺老孙看懂了。”大圣打断她，“不就是翻跟头、耍棍子、打妖怪嘛，这还用教？”温栩栩还没来得及反驳，就感觉自已的手指不受控制地动了起来。点开训练营，选英雄，进游戏——一套动作行云流水，快得她眼睛都跟不上。屏幕上的孙悟空开始翻跟头、敲棍子、打野怪，那操作流畅得像是本尊钻进了游戏里。“这皮肤太丑了。”大圣忽然开口，“俺老孙什么时候穿过这身花里胡哨的？给我换掉。”温栩栩弱弱地问：“那您想用哪个皮肤？还有别的款……”“不换了。”大圣打断她，“就原皮。俺老孙本尊长什么样，游戏里就什么样。”温栩栩默默点头，心想：行吧，大圣就是大圣，原皮也挡不住那气质。——深夜。偌大的别墅里，只有二楼一个房间亮着微弱的光。温栩栩盘腿坐在床上，双手捧着手机，屏幕的光映在她脸上，一闪一闪的。而她的手指正在手机屏幕上飞快点动——如果旁边有人的话，一定会被吓到。太快了。快得只剩残影。点击、滑动、连招、切换视角……一气呵成，根本不像人类的手速。游戏里，孙悟空正在对面高地一打三。三杀。Victory！MVP。温栩栩已经顾不上说话了。她只感觉自已像个被绑在驾驶座上的乘客，眼睁睁看着“自已”在峡谷里大杀四方，一局接一局，根本停不下来。她从千元机换到水果机，买了个游戏账号，段位是铂金。而现在，在大圣操控之下， 把把连胜，已经在星耀了，离最强王者不远了！！温栩栩盯着屏幕上那个闪闪发光的段位图标，人都麻了。这才三个小时啊？而游戏好友列表疯狂跳动。【用户89757申请加你为好友】【峡谷最强申请加你为好友】【求带飞申请加你为好友】……消息栏更是炸了：“大神！求带！”“带带带带带带带我！”“兄弟你这猴子怎么练的？也太6了，职业选手吧？”温栩栩看着那些消息，默默咽了口唾沫。嗯，何止是职业选手，是本尊来了！温栩栩扭头看了一眼窗外——月亮挂在天边，又大又圆。再低头看了一眼手机屏幕右上角的时间。凌晨两点整。温栩栩心情逐渐复杂。害怕一个人睡觉呢？现在根本不用害怕了。因为根本——不用——睡了！！！大圣越打越上头，一局接一局，完全没有停下来的意思。温栩栩感觉自已像个被绑架的司机，眼睁睁看着“自已”在峡谷里杀疯了。杀完对面杀野怪，杀完野怪推塔，推完塔再杀对面。杀完一局，秒开下一局。温栩栩终于回过味儿来了。等等。自已和大圣之前都没什么交集，大圣为什么这么积极响应？二话不说就来了？这分明是在天上玩腻了，想附身她来人间浪一浪吧？温栩栩越想越觉得对。大圣是什么人？天不怕地不怕，最喜欢新鲜玩意儿。在天庭待了几千年，能玩的花样早玩遍了。现在好不容易有个机会来人间“实地体验”，那还不得玩个够？什么检查周围的危险都是顺手。真实目的就是：想打游戏！！！温栩栩忍不住笑了。行吧，不愧是大圣，这性格，一点没变。她往后一仰，瘫在床上，放弃挣扎。打吧打吧，您老人家开心就好。反正她现在有大圣附身，不用睡也电量满格。凌晨三点十五分。温栩栩已经彻底放弃挣扎，瘫在床上当一条咸鱼，任由大圣操控着她的身体在峡谷里大杀四方。屏幕上的匹配倒计时正在跳动。3秒。2秒。1秒。——就在即将进入游戏的瞬间，手指忽然一顿。取消了匹配。温栩栩一愣，脑子瞬间清醒：“怎么了大圣？玩累了？”不像啊，刚才那势头明明还能再战三百回合。“累？”大圣的声音在脑子里响起，带着几分警觉，“俺老孙会累？”“那您怎么——”“我刚刚眼皮跳了一下。”大圣难得严肃起来，“不对劲。”话音刚落，手机屏幕自动熄灭了。卧室瞬间陷入黑暗。没有游戏的光，没有音效，什么都没有。安静得能听见自已的心跳。温栩栩后背一凉，下意识屏住呼吸。大圣眼皮跳？这不是普通的眼皮跳。小时候听老人讲西游记，说大圣有一种本事叫“心惊肉跳”——遇到危险或者埋伏，他就会莫名心慌、眼皮狂跳，提前感应到不对劲。这种类似第六感的警觉，帮师徒四人躲过了多少劫难。现在，大圣感觉到了什么？
content_en: Wen Xuxu tentatively asked, "What about the game? Great Sage, do you want to try the mobile game in our world?" The Great Sage became excited when he heard the word "game" and raised his eyebrows: "Game? What game?" Wen Xuxu clicked on the King of Pesticide mobile game and turned to the hero list: "Look!" On the screen, a character wearing a purple gold crown with phoenix wings, chained gold armor, and a Ruyi golden hoop stood majestically.The hero character has three big characters written on it: Sun Wukong.The great sage was stunned.He stared at the character for three seconds, then moved closer, and looked at it for another three seconds.Then he spoke, and his voice changed: "This...is this my grandson?" Wen Xuxu nodded vigorously: "Yes! We in the mortal world worship you! You are a superhero. You are in games, movies, and cartoons - all protagonists who can go to heaven and earth!" "Oh?" The great sage used Wen Xuxu's face to make a "tell me" expression, sayingBut she could no longer hide her pride in her anger, "Are they all protagonists? Are they all the ones who kill everyone and are invincible?" Wen Xuxu nodded frantically: "Yes, yes, yes! You will always be the most powerful one!" As soon as she finished speaking, the expression on her face suddenly changed - her eyebrows were raised, the corners of her mouth were crooked, with a bit of "needless to say" attitude, it was the expression of Sun Wukong.The next second it cut back to herself, nodding crazily with bright eyes.The next second, Sun Wukong appeared again, with a satisfied smile on her face that said, "You mortals are discerning."One face, two expressions, switching like flipping through a book.If someone pushed in the door at this moment, they would definitely think that Wen Xuxu was schizophrenic.The Great Sage gave a satisfied "Hmm" and used Wen Xuxu's body to hold the phone tightly. He stared at himself on the screen wearing a purple gold crown with phoenix wings and holding a Ruyi golden hoop, his eyes getting brighter and brighter.The Great Sage looked left, looked right, zoomed in and out, and then zoomed in again.Then he muttered in a low voice: "...It's a bit interesting." The Great Sage was eager to try the game King Pesticide: "Girl, how do you play this thing?" Wen Xuxu clicked on the game called King of Glory and began to be the commentator for the Great Sage: "This is you, Sun WuKong, the jungle position, his skills are..." "Okay, okay, I understand." The Great Sage interrupted her, "Isn't it just somersaults, stick play, and monster fighting?Do you need to teach me this?" Before Wen Xuxu could refute, he felt his fingers moving uncontrollably.Click on the training camp, choose a hero, and enter the game - a set of actions flowed so smoothly that her eyes couldn't keep up.The Monkey King on the screen started to do somersaults, hit sticks, and fight wild monsters. The operation was as smooth as if he had entered the game."This skin is too ugly." The Great Sage suddenly said, "When has my old grandson ever worn such a gaudy outfit? Change it for me." Wen Xuxu asked weakly: "Then which skin do you want to use? There are other styles..." "I won't change it." The great sage interrupted her, "Just the original skin. What I, the old sun, look like in the game." Wen Xuxu nodded silently, thinking: OK, the great sage is the great sage, and the original skin can't stop his temperament.--late at night.In the huge villa, only one room on the second floor was dimly lit.Wen Xuxu sat cross-legged on the bed, holding her mobile phone in both hands, and the light from the screen flickered on her face.And her fingers were moving rapidly on the phone screen - if there was anyone next to her, they would definitely be scared.Too fast.So fast that only the afterimage remains.Click, slide, combo, switch perspectives... all in one go, not like human hand speed at all.In the game, Sun Wukong is fighting three on the opposite high ground.Three kills.Victory!MVP.Wen Xuxu no longer cared about talking.She just felt like a passenger tied to the driver's seat, watching "self" killing everyone in the canyon, one round after another, unable to stop at all.She switched from the thousand-yuan machine to the fruit machine, bought a game account, and her rank was platinum.But now, under the control of the Great Sage, a winning streak has been achieved in Xingyao, and he is not far away from becoming the strongest king!!Wen Xuxu stared at the gleaming rank icon on the screen, feeling numb.It's only been three hours?And the game friends list is jumping like crazy.[User 89757 applied to add you as a friend] [The strongest in the canyon applied to add you as a friend] [Please guide Fei to apply to add you as a friend]... The message column exploded: "Master! Please guide me!" "Brother, how do you practice like a monkey? You are too 6, a professional player, right?" Wen Xuxu looked at the messages and swallowed silently.Well, it’s not just a professional player, it’s me!Wen Xuxu turned and glanced out the window - the moon was hanging in the sky, big and round.He looked down at the time in the upper right corner of the phone screen again.It's two o'clock in the morning.Wen Xuxu's mood gradually became complicated.Afraid of sleeping alone?There is no need to be afraid now.Because there is no need to sleep at all!!!The Monkey King got higher and higher, one game after another, with no intention of stopping.Wen Xuxu felt like a kidnapped driver, watching "himself" go crazy in the canyon.After killing the enemy, kill the wild monsters. After killing the wild monsters, push the tower. After pushing the tower, kill the opponent again.After killing one round, start the next one instantly.Wen Xuxu finally came back to his senses.etc.I have never had any interaction with the Great Sage before, so why did the Great Sage respond so positively?Came here without saying a word?He's obviously tired of playing in heaven and wants to possess her and come to earth for a while, right?The more Wen Xuxu thought about it, the more he felt it was right.Who is the Great Sage?He is not afraid of anything, and he likes new things the most.After staying in heaven for thousands of years, I have already played all the tricks I can play.Now that we finally have the opportunity to "experience it on the ground" in the human world, why don't we have enough fun?It's easy to check for dangers around you.The real purpose is: I want to play games!!!Wen Xuxu couldn't help but laugh.Okay, he is worthy of being a great sage, his character has not changed at all.She leaned back, collapsed on the bed, and gave up struggling.Fight, fight, as long as you are happy.Anyway, she is now possessed by a great sage, so she has a full battery without having to sleep.Three fifteen in the morning.Wen Xuxu had completely given up struggling and slumped on the bed like a salted fish, letting the Great Sage control her body to kill everyone in the canyon.The match countdown on the screen is beating.3 seconds.2 seconds.1 second.——Just when he was about to enter the game, his fingers suddenly stopped.Match canceled.Wen Xuxu was stunned, and his mind suddenly cleared: "What's wrong, Great Sage? Are you tired from playing?" It's not like that, the momentum just now can obviously be used for another 300 rounds."Tired?" The Great Sage's voice sounded in his mind, with a bit of vigilance, "I, Old Sun, will be tired?" "Then what are you -" "My eyelids just jumped." The Great Sage rarely became serious, "Something's wrong." As soon as he finished speaking, the phone screen automatically turned off.The bedroom instantly fell into darkness.No game lights, no sound effects, nothing.So quiet that you can hear your own heartbeat.Wen Xuxu's back felt cold and she subconsciously held her breath.The great sage's eyelids twitched?This is no ordinary eyelid twitching.When I was a child, I heard an old man tell me about Journey to the West, saying that the Great Sage had a skill called "frightening" - when encountering danger or an ambush, he would be inexplicably panicked, his eyelids would twitch wildly, and he would sense something was wrong in advance.This kind of vigilance, similar to the sixth sense, helped the four masters and apprentices avoid many disasters.Now, what does the Great Sage feel?
